tool.name: FAIRe mapper: identify your files
tool.description: say what each file is and where it goes

param.name: files
param.label: Your files
param.help: Every file you have for the dataset: sample sheets, OTU or ASV tables, taxonomy tables, sequences (FASTA), run reports, methods (text or PDF) or ReadMe texts. Each sheet of an Excel file is reported on its own.

has_line_matching.expression: ^otu_asv_table\.tsv\t\tOTU or ASV table\t.*4 column headers are sample names.*
^otu_curated\.csv\t\tOTU or ASV table\t.*Column of curated names.*
^library_sra_sheet\.xlsx\tSRA_data\tlibrary table\t.*library names \(library_ID\) with their sequence files \(filename\).*
^library_md5sum\.txt\t\tlibrary table\t.*checksums and file names, as md5sum writes them.*
^library_file_names\.txt\t\tlibrary table\t.*a list of sequence file names, one per line.*
^otu_lca_ranks\.fasta\t\tsequences \(FASTA\)\t.*4 sequences of 77 bases, each after a header line starting with > \(ASV_1, ASV_2, ASV_3 \.\.\.\).*Sequences of this table \(FASTA\).*
^primer_methods\.pdf\t\ttext\t.*a PDF of 1 page; 45 words.*find primers can read it.*
